neet_phy_u02_t12_2.working: In 2 s the velocity turns through (2/12)*360° = 60°. |Δv| = 2v sin(30°) = 2*10*0.5 = 10 m s^-1

neet_phy_u02_t12_4.working: Speed is constant, so KE is constant: A is true. Centripetal acceleration has constant magnitude but its direction keeps changing, so it is not a constant vector: R is false.

neet_phy_u02_t12_5.working: I: a = ω^2 r with ω the same, so 2r gives double, not four times: I is incorrect. II: over half a revolution, displacement = 2r and time = πr/v, so average velocity = 2v/π ≠ v: II is incorrect.
